# Endurance: Enraged
Characters with 10 Endurance automatically become [bold]Enraged[/bold] when an injury would put them into critical condition or kill them. This also prevents soft critical condition.
Enraged lasts [bold]10 seconds[/bold]. During that time, you cannot enter critical condition or die, but you take [bold]25% more damage[/bold]. Movement slowdowns are ignored for the duration. Normal slowdowns return when it ends. It does not heal you: damage continues to accumulate.
[bold]Healing and chems are blocked while Enraged.[/bold] You cannot eat, drink, or receive injections or medical treatment. Chemical effects already in your bloodstream are also suppressed until the state ends. Other players cannot heal you through it.
When Enraged ends, critical condition and death apply normally again. Injuries that are still lethal can kill you immediately.
Enraged has a [bold]five-minute cooldown[/bold], measured from activation. It cannot activate again during that cooldown.
Endurance 5 gives no health bonus. Above that, your bonus health is [bold]6 Endurance: +2.7; 7: +6; 8: +10; 9: +14.7; 10: +20[/bold] (rounded). This increases the damage you can take before critical condition and death; it does not heal existing injuries. Endurance below 5 reduces those thresholds. At 10 Endurance, you receive both the +20 health bonus and Enraged.
